description: Two to five BTS/MRT stations, lines, districts, neighbourhoods or residences side by side: listings, median price, typical range (middle half) and price per m², for rent or sale, optionally for one number of bedrooms. Returns each place's bkkradar.com page.

bedrooms.description: Compare this number of bedrooms only; 0 = studio, 3 or more = the 3+ group.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese) or zh (simplified Chinese). Use the user's language.

places.description: 2 to 5 places separated by commas: BTS/MRT stations, lines, districts, neighbourhoods or residences, e.g. "Asok, Thonglor, Ari, Life Asoke". A station's name means the station: write "Silom district" or "Ari neighbourhood" for the area.

name: compare_areas
title: Compare areas
